result_summary: Primary source and exact repository inspection support an LLM-free semantic segmenter followed by single-call typed memory encoding and structured query planning. For F2, reuse only the thin batching/segmentation and typed-derived-record mechanism over immutable UnifiedDB provenance; do not import a second truth store or treat similarity as context-admission authority.
key_source_observations: OnlineSemanticChunker is LLM-free, tracks one open chunk per session, uses embedding-distribution change plus bounded length hazards, and records boundary decisions.
Default 1000/1500/2000 token preferences bound chunk size; session flush and oversized/capacity paths are explicit.
CompactSemanticEncoder makes one LLM call per finalized chunk and outputs typed MemoryRecord objects with temporal/provenance fields.
SearchPlan supports temporal constraints and independent evidence routes.
LycheeMemory V2 reports 89.22% LoCoMo, 92.20% LongMemEval-S, and 86.0%/75.9% construction-token reductions versus A-Mem; these are paper claims, not reproduced F2 evidence.

cross_research.LongMemEval-V2: Use environment-experience abilities—state tracking, workflows, gotchas, premise awareness—as F2 evaluation dimensions.
cross_research.MemGate_arXiv_2606.06054: Treat retrieval as a trust boundary; similarity alone is not sufficient for prompt admission.

candidate_f2_architecture: UnifiedDB causal events -> hard causal/lifecycle/generation fences -> optional LLM-free semantic subsegmentation -> DerivedMemorySegmentEnvelope (noncanonical) -> typed extraction/provenance -> deterministic retrieval admission -> semantic/rerank selection -> bounded ContextView
counterhypotheses: Semantic boundaries can split action/outcome causality or merge distinct events.
Delayed segment finalization can hide a critical observation at decision time.
Derived records can become a second truth authority if provenance/admission is weak.
Conversation-style segmentation may underperform deterministic causal boundaries on action-heavy F2 traces.
next_exact_gate: Acquire E2_ARCHITECTURE_MAPPED create-only claim in F2, map exact WP300/WP301/WP303/WP306 interfaces and define a falsifiable four-arm segmentation benchmark before any build-candidate handoff.
